item.title: Patch now: Multiple critical vulnerabilities affect PHP
item.description:
PHP (multiple products): fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for the affected PHP products. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available
